recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍（A）可見與周圍造血細胞明顯分開、緊密黏聚成團的非造血細胞群（箭頭），高倍（B）為大小一致、細胞質稀少、核互相擠壓的小圓形細胞，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（small round blue cell tumor）。
features: Large cohesive syncytial cluster of tumor cells distinct from dispersed marrow elements (panel A, arrow)
Small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio and scant, poorly defined cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; focal nuclear molding within clusters
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles at cell edges (panel B)
Background hematopoietic cells present; staining has an unusual red-orange cast that limits chromatin detail
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows, at low power, a large cohesive cluster of tumor cells that is clearly separate from the dispersed background hematopoietic elements. At high power the cells are small-to-medium, round, with high N:C ratios, finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, scant cytoplasm, and focal nuclear molding; a few cells show small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Definite rosettes or fibrillary neuropil are not clearly resolved, and the red-orange staining cast limits fine detail. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round cell tumor, in keeping with metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation by biopsy with immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin; CD45 negative) and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly rather than in cohesive clusters with molding, and are CD45/TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive by flow, whereas neuroblastoma is CD45-negative and CD56/GD2 positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells may also cluster and contain cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles, and are separated by CD99/NKX2.2 positivity and EWSR1 rearrangement rather than PHOX2B.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often have more abundant, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm and occasional multinucleation, and express desmin and myogenin.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles, are non-cohesive, and are CD45/CD20/CD10 positive with MYC rearrangement.
